title: supertask once never promo
name: Supertask once never promo
rule: Supertask button once; never for promo; link-style button for rare actions. Supertask launches the page’s main task (apply / calculator / wizard). Not for promotion (use feature patterns). Primary still ≤1 per page (dual-cite Actions). Link buttons = infrequent (restart calculator) with a larger hit area than a text link. Danger only when consequences are real.
pass_when: At most one supertask; it starts the main task; not used for promo; ≤1 primary; link-style only for rare actions with a larger hit area; danger only for real consequences.
fail_when: Two supertasks; supertask used as promo; two primaries; danger used without real consequences.
overview: One supertask button starts the page’s main task; never use it for promo.
apply_when: Placing the main apply, calculator, or wizard launch on a Canada.ca page.
not_when: Feature/promo patterns — those are not the supertask control.
agent_hint: One supertask for the main task; link-style for rare actions; danger only if real.
description: A Canada.ca supertask button appears once and launches the page’s main task (apply, calculator, wizard). Never use it for promotion — use feature patterns instead. Keep primary at most one per page (dual-cite Actions). Link-style buttons cover infrequent actions (restart calculator) with a larger hit area than a text link. Danger only when consequences are real. Fail two supertasks, promo-as-supertask, two primaries, or danger without real consequences.
do_not_claim: A second primary class that beats Actions one-primary.
